_comment: Config for the epi linelist aggregation/nowcasting/plotting/mapping pipeline in this repo. Adapted from BDBV2026-Linelist_Processing's pipelines/pipeline_configs.json: this repo has no raw_subdir (no raw exports land here) and reads dhis2_processed_linelist_ctsafe.csv (the de-identified snapshot auto-synced from BDBV2026-Linelist_Processing) instead of the full dhis2_processed_linelist.csv. Update epi_linelist.nowcasting.analysis_start when the analytic window changes, to match the upstream repo's config.

province._min_confirmed_cases_note: Provinces with total confirmed cases strictly greater than this value are included in province-level nowcasting and growth-rate outputs.

delay_distribution_fit._comment: Config for the onset-to-reporting delay distribution fit in 1-fit_delay_distributions.R (epidist/cmdstanr). onset_cutoff_start excludes a known onset-date data-quality issue prior to that date -- confirm/update periodically as data quality upstream changes.
delay_distribution_fit._case_groups_comment: Each group gets its own separate set of delay fits (outputs under delay_distributions/<group>/<delay>/). Values are final_mve_case_classification codes.

date_imputation._comment: Config for imputing missing/out-of-range onset dates in 2-date_imputation.R, by sampling from the best-fit onset_to_reporting_days distribution (delay_distribution_fit_summary.csv, written by 1-fit_delay_distributions.R). interval_width sets the [lower, upper] onset-date interval recorded per imputed row (0.95 = the fitted delay's 2.5th/97.5th percentile). max_resample_attempts bounds how many times an out-of-[min_days, max_days] draw is redrawn before it's clamped instead. random_seed is fixed so reruns against unchanged data reproduce the same imputed dates rather than reshuffling them every run.
date_imputation._case_group_comment: Which delay_distribution_fit.case_groups entry's onset_to_reporting_days fit is used to impute onset dates (applied to every row needing imputation).

reporting_backfill._comment: Config for 6-reporting-backfill.R. Compares status_aggregated.csv from every past outputs/<DATE>/ folder (up to and including this run's date) against this run's own, to estimate how complete each onset date's count is N days after onset (backfilling). This run's counts are treated as the reference ('eventual') counts, but only for onset dates at least settled_after_days old -- newer dates are still filling in themselves. Onset dates before onset_start are left out (early exports had a different onset-date data-quality profile; see delay_distribution_fit.onset_cutoff_start). min_reference_count drops onset dates with too few reference cases for a per-date ratio to mean much (they still count towards the pooled completeness). completeness_thresholds are the levels reported in backfill_summary.json as 'days until X% complete'. Plots are only drawn for national plus locations with at least min_location_cases_for_plot reference cases.
reporting_backfill._spatial_scales_comment: spatial_scales: completeness is calculated (backfill_completeness_by_lag.csv, backfill_summary.json) at each of these. snapshot_csv_spatial_scales: the much bigger per-onset-date backfill_snapshots.csv is only written for these (health zones would add ~100k rows to every dated folder). plot_spatial_scales: plots are only drawn for these.
reporting_backfill._comparison_plots_comment: comparison_plot_spatial_scales: one extra completeness plot per scale comparing all its locations with at least min_location_cases_for_plot reference cases (plus national as a dotted reference line), each with its 10th-90th percentile ribbon. Up to comparison_plot_max_single_panel locations share one panel; more than that are drawn as small multiples, one panel per location.

across_exports._comment: Running files under outputs/<dir>/ (no date in the path) that build up one export at a time, rather than being rewritten from scratch in each dated outputs/<DATE>/ folder. Each run replaces its own export_date's rows (so reruns/pinned-date runs never duplicate) and fills in any earlier dated folder not in the file yet. Currently written by 6-reporting-backfill.R. status_aggregated_national is every export's national status_aggregated.csv rows stacked, with an export_date column: the epi curve as it looked in each export.

contact_tracing._comment: Config for the contact tracing pipeline (pipelines/contact_tracing_pipeline/). Inputs are read from data/<DATE>/ (latest folder containing both files below, or CT_PIPELINE_DATE); outputs go to outputs/<DATE>/<outputs_subdir>/. Imputed onset dates are optional and come from the epi linelist pipeline's step 2 output for the same date, if it exists.
contact_tracing._known_followup_results_comment: Standard (mapped) followup_result values. Anything else is kept as-is in the pairs table but listed in the DQ issues file -- add it to assets/maps/followup_result_map.csv upstream to fix it at source.
